note: This governance's fragment of the promulgation boundary — composed with the harness base declaration and every other activated governance's fragment at sync time (Plan-033, ADR-0019). Read, never re-decided at a call site. This package ships no record, so there is no template/authoring/migrations entry here — only the three scaffold files it writes (Plan-040 Track 5). THESE THREE PATHS WERE UNCONDITIONAL BEFORE, in the harness base fragment, and are now conditional on `instructions` being bound — which it is by default. A repository that deliberately unbinds it has no claimant for them, and the consequence is a REFUSAL rather than an unguarded write: `harness sync` collects an unclaimed path into `unclassified` and throws, because absence of an entry is not permission. That is the same repository saying it does not want this governance, so nothing ships these files to it either; the pairing is deliberate, not an oversight.

paths.why: A mechanical `@AGENTS.md` import and nothing else. Byte-identical in every repository measured 2026-08-13 — this package's scaffold copy is the one byte-identical source, so promulgation may overwrite it safely.

Ships with a placeholder — a TODO description and a comment block telling the operator to replace it or delete the file — so it is a prompt, not content. Written once when absent; the repository owns it from the moment it exists.
A placeholder that lets the empty .agents/skills/ directory survive under version control. Deleted the moment the directory gets real content; re-creating it after that would be noise.
